summary: Kyivstar Group Ltd., a Dubai-domiciled Nasdaq-listed Ukrainian telecom registrant, furnished a Form 6-K corresponding to its quarterly report for the period ended 30 September 2026. The exhibit is XBRL-tagged interim financial statements and notes, covering equity roll-forward, share-based payment reserves and translation reserves, with comparative 2025 periods. No transaction, stake, price, board recommendation or advisor is disclosed. The filing maps to a routine US quarterly report on Form 10-Q-equivalent basis. What to watch: operating trends in the Ukrainian telecom market and any currency or war-related disclosures, not an event-driven situation.
